description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment of the Subjects and Functions of the Departments, Statutory Institutions and Public Corporations
reasoning: This gazette contains both specific personnel references (President Gotabaya Rajapaksa is named as the issuing authority) and detailed portfolio responsibilities. It amends previous notifications by outlining the specific departments, statutory institutions, public corporations, and laws under the purview of several ministers (Minister of Technology, State Minister of Prison Management, Foreign Minister, Minister of Health). The content provides both the "who" (the President) and the "what" (the detailed institutional and legal frameworks for various ministries), making it a Hybrid gazette.
